name: rails
description: Guard hooks for shell commands: deny destructive commands, ask before a push to main or a force-push. No hook in this plugin ever allows.

push_to_main.title: Push to main
push_to_main.description: What the git guard does before a push that updates main or master: ask (the floor) or deny.

force_push.title: Force-push
force_push.description: What the git guard does before a force, delete, mirror or prune push: ask (the floor) or deny.

commit_style.title: Commit style
commit_style.description: What the git guard does when a git commit -m subject is not conventional (feat:, fix:, docs: and the rest): off, ask, or deny.
